abstract: Tissues from the surgical specimen of 7 patients with testicular embryonal carcinoma were cultivated in vitro. Among 7 primary cultures, initial growth of tumor cells was observed in 5 cases. One of them was successfully subcultured and a cell line, designated NEC-8, has been established. NEC-8 cells grow as a flat epithelial colony densely packed with polygonal cells and gradually pile up at the center of the colony. Ultrastructure of NEC-8 cell revealed desmosomes and microvilli at the cell membrane. The cytoplasm was characteristically rich in glycogen granules which corresponded with strong PAS reaction. The chromosome number of NEC-8 cells at passage 3 showed wide distribution from 70 to 183, with a mode of 85 to 88. Histology of the heterotransplant of NEC-8 cells into the hamster cheek pouch was that of adenocarcinoma resembling a part of the histology of the original tumor.
abstract_ja: 手術検体から採取した7例の精巣胎児性癌組織をin vitroで培養した。初代培養7例中5例で腫瘍細胞の初期増殖が認められ、そのうち1株の継代に成功し、細胞株NEC-8を樹立した。NEC-8細胞は扁平な上皮様のコロニーを形成し、コロニー中心部で多角形の細胞が次第に重層化した。細胞膜にはデスモソームと微絨毛が認められ、細胞質はPAS反応陽性のグリコーゲン顆粒に富んでいた。継代3代目の染色体数は70から183まで広く分布し、最頻値は85～88であった。NEC-8細胞をハムスター頬袋に異種移植すると、原腫瘍の組織像の一部に類似した腺癌様の組織像を示した。
